false_positive_review.evidence: The source selector is .markdown blockquote, not a card; a single logical-start border is a conventional semantic quotation treatment.

The source is border-radius: clamp(8px, 1vw, 16px); the detector reported the malformed literal "1vw,". Whether the clamp endpoints belong to the documented radius scale was not judged because DESIGN.md was intentionally not read.

detector.qualification: Type-ramp, palette, and radius-scale advisories are preserved as deterministic evidence but are not promoted to visual defects here because the assessment was explicitly prohibited from reading DESIGN.md for aesthetic judgment.

browser.selected_browser: Chrome extension via Browser skill URL selection

fresh_tab.navigation_call_result: The goto call timed out, but a subsequent read-only tab state check showed the requested homepage URL and title had loaded.

mutable_injection_preflight.method: Chrome CUA address-bar javascript URL intended to set document.title and append a script element
mutable_injection_preflight.exact_fallback_signal: js execution timed out; kernel reset, rerun your request
mutable_injection_preflight.post_attempt_observation: A later browser tab listing still showed the homepage title as "Wait For It"; no successful title mutation or appended script was verified.
mutable_injection_preflight.decision: Mutation was treated as unavailable. Read-only Playwright evaluate was not counted as mutation.

overlay.reason: The mutable injection preflight was not verified.

desktop.evidence: Only homepage URL and title were observed before repeated browser-control timeouts.

mobile_390x844.evidence: Viewport testing was not reached because repeated browser tab operations timed out and reset browser control.

representative_route_evidence.http_fallback_scope: This proves server reachability, status, document title, and default html language only; it is not a substitute for visual or computed-style evidence.

browser_control_diagnostics: Repeated browser operations reported Statsig initialization/registration network timeouts.
The mutation-preflight operation timed out and reset the browser-control kernel.
console.claim_about_app_console: No claim is made that the application console is error-free.

visibility.reason: The overlay procedure permits presentation only after mutable injection succeeds; it did not.

tab_cleanup.reason: The parent checkpoint explicitly ordered all new browser operations to stop immediately after repeated resets; no further finalize call was made.

browser_tabs.reason: Browser activity was stopped by parent checkpoint before a finalization call.

observations: The detector's side-tab selector targets .markdown blockquote.
The detector's malformed 1vw, radius report comes from a clamp(8px, 1vw, 16px) declaration.
The very large SiteHeader radius values are used on pill-like controls, so their geometry appears deliberate even though scale conformance was not judged.
The rgb(1000, 1000, 1000) literals occur in global foreground and link treatment declarations and remain valid deterministic palette findings.

limitations: Browser screenshots, DOM snapshots, computed styles, desktop visual inspection, mobile 390x844 inspection, and page-console evidence were not completed.
Browser tabs created during failed attempts were not finalized because the parent ordered browser activity to stop immediately.
